notes: The list already covers Fauré's original violin works: both sonatas, the Berceuse Op. 16, the Romance Op. 28, the Andante Op. 75, the Concerto Op. 14 fragment and the short Pièce. It also includes the two most played arrangements (Après un rêve, Sicilienne). Other transcriptions, such as the Élégie Op. 24 and the Romance sans paroles Op. 17 No. 3, have no established edition by a notable violinist that I can name with confidence, so I have added nothing.
